title: "Bills"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false

---

```{r}
library(gt)
source("scripts/shared.R")

senators <- load_senators()
ns       <- senator_name_sets(senators)
votes    <- load_all_votes(ns)

bills <- load_bills() |>
  left_join(senators |> select(name_join, District, Party), by = "name_join") |>
  bill_statuses(votes) |>
  mutate(
    # The bill number links to the bill's page; the PDF lives there.
    bill_link = sprintf("[%s](%s/%s.html)", bill_measure, BILL_PAGES_DIR, url_slug),
    # Status dot: green = passed, red = dead, gold = moving
    Status = sprintf(
      '<span class="status-dot %s"></span> %s',
      case_when(
        status == "Passed Senate" ~ "s-pass",
        grepl("^Failed", status)  ~ "s-fail",
        TRUE                      ~ "s-active"
      ),
      status
    )
  )

# Each bill's most recent vote (if any), from whichever committee took it.
latest_votes <- bind_rows(votes, .id = "source") |>
  select(any_of(c("source", "Date", "Bill", "Vote", "Result")))

if (nrow(latest_votes) > 0) {
  latest_votes <- latest_votes |>
    group_by(Bill) |>
    slice_max(Date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(source = COMMITTEE_NAMES[source])
  bills <- left_join(bills, latest_votes, by = c("bill_measure" = "Bill"))
} else {
  # No votes anywhere yet (start of semester): show the columns empty.
  bills <- bills |> mutate(Vote = NA, Date = NA, source = NA, Result = NA)
}

bills |>
  select(bill_link, title, name, Status, committee, appropriations,
         Vote, Result) |>
  gt() |>
  sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "") |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = c("Status", "bill_link")) |>
  tab_options(table.width = pct(100)) |>
  cols_label(
    bill_link = "Bill",
    title = "Subject",
    name = "Author",
    Status = "Status",
    committee = "Committee",
    appropriations = "Fiscal",
    Vote = "Latest Vote (A-N-Ab-Abs)",
    Result = "Result"
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Bills",
    subtitle = "Click a bill number for its full page — text, tracker, votes, and letters"
  ) |>
  opt_interactive(
    use_sorting = TRUE,
    use_search = TRUE,
    use_filters = FALSE,
    use_resizers = TRUE,
    use_highlight = TRUE,
    page_size_default = 5
  ) |>
  opt_row_striping()
```
